svg.title: Annex A3 · n8n in the cloud (AWS): second copy and helper workflows
svg.desc: The n8n collector node by node (registry, two passes, copy, parentless commit to data-n8n) and the watchdog, validation and extraction workflows, built and tested from the repository.
svg.text: Annex A3 · n8n in the cloud (AWS): second copy and helper workflows

Four n8n workflows run outside GitHub, on a colleague's n8n on AWS (US). The collector leaves a second copy every night of everything that is neither blocked nor forbidden, whether Actions fails or not; the others watch the site,
measure reachability on demand and help read reports with a language model. Each node's code lives in the repository (n8n/) and is built with build.mjs.
Details these boxes of the full diagram: n8n collector (AWS cloud), data-n8n branch, n8n operator (colleague).
Node.js · build.mjs · tests on real n8n (n8n.yml)
Schedule, HTTP Request, Split in Batches and Code
Git Data API with the “GitHub ENSO (n8n)”

g.title: 1. Node code → build.mjs → dist/: code and registry. build.mjs inserts the lib/ and nodes/ code into each node, plus a copy of the source registry.
2. build.mjs → dist/ → n8n operator (colleague): dist/ workflows. Nodes are regenerated with build.mjs: a change is re-imported, not edited in n8n.
3. n8n operator (colleague) → Trigger and settings: imports, credential and activates. Picks the “GitHub ENSO (n8n)” credential on each node that talks to GitHub and activates the workflow.
4. Trigger and settings → Read registry and previous copy: 22:50 Lima. Runs every night, whether Actions failed or not: the copy is ready when the 23:37 run looks for it.
5. Read registry and previous copy → Sources: registry and previous copy. If the GitHub registry cannot be read, it uses the copy embedded at build time.
6. Sources → Download, one at a time: URLs assigned to n8n. Only those the registry gives n8n: all three collectors read the same list.
7. Download, one at a time → Second pass: transient failures. What failed by timeout, connection, 5xx or 429 is retried once; if there is nothing to retry, this branch does not run.
8. Download, one at a time → Prepare copy: first pass. Good answers from the first pass go straight to the copy.
9. Second pass → Prepare copy: second pass. “Merge passes” joins both before building the copy.
10. Prepare copy → Create blobs: new files. Unchanged files reuse their blob: the upload is small.
11. Create blobs → Tree and parentless commit: blobs ready. The tree and the commit are built from the blobs.
12. Tree and parentless commit → data-n8n branch: parentless commit. The branch is replaced (force): history does not grow; data-archive keeps what the pipeline uses.
13. data-n8n branch → Read registry and previous copy: previous copy (72 h). Its “Read previous copy” node reads data-n8n to keep the URLs that failed tonight.
14. data-n8n branch → Notify the site (off): optional. If enabled, the update runs right away; if not, the 23:37 run uses the copy.
Node code. lib/ (answer and block classifier, SHA-256 and SHA-1, ENFEN PDFs, copy assembly) and nodes/ (each Code node's body). It is not edited in the n8n interface. Technology: JavaScript, Node 22.

g.title: build.mjs → dist/. Builds the 4 importable workflows and embeds a registry copy. n8n.yml checks that dist/ matches the code and tests them on real n8n with a fake GitHub API. Technology: node --test, n8n en Docker.
g.text: embeds a registry copy. n8n.yml checks that
dist/ matches the code and tests them on real
n8n with a fake GitHub API.

g.title: n8n operator (colleague). Imports the dist/ workflows, picks the GitHub credential (fine-grained token, Contents read and write, 1 year) and activates the scheduled ones; may give them an Error workflow that sends an email.

g.title: Trigger and settings. cron 50 22 * * * in the America/Lima zone, or “Run by hand”. Settings: repository, data-n8n branch, 72 h carry and 8 MB per file. Technology: Schedule Trigger, Set.

g.title: Read registry and previous copy. Reads registry/sources.json from main through the GitHub API and the current index.json of data-n8n. Technology: HTTP Request.

a.title: Annex A1: Sources, reachability and registry

g.title: Sources. Keeps the URLs the registry gives n8n (and their mirrors): skips the forbidden, the reader and the Peru-only ones. 152 URLs. Technology: Code.
g.text: Keeps the URLs the registry gives n8n (and
their mirrors): skips the forbidden, the reader

g.title: Download, one at a time. One URL at a time, up to 10 redirects and a 40 s timeout; “Analyze” classifies each answer with the same rules as Actions and Peru. Technology: Split in Batches, HTTP Request, Code.
g.text: One URL at a time, up to 10 redirects and a
answer with the same rules as Actions and

g.title: Second pass. After 30 s it retries what failed for transient reasons (timeout, connection, 5xx, 429) with a 60 s timeout, and fetches the ENFEN PDFs and the links the registry asks for. Technology: Wait, Code.
g.text: After 30 s it retries what failed for transient
a 60 s timeout, and fetches the ENFEN PDFs
and the links the registry asks for.

g.title: Prepare copy. Merges both passes and builds index.json and heartbeat.json (enso-relay/1). Keeps for up to 72 h the good copy of a URL that failed tonight, marked carried. Technology: Merge, Code.
g.text: Merges both passes and builds index.json and
72 h the good copy of a URL that failed

g.title: Create blobs. Uploads only the new files, one every 0.8 s; those already on the branch are reused by their git SHA-1. Technology: POST git/blobs.

g.title: Tree and parentless commit. Builds the tree with index.json, heartbeat.json and files/, and a parentless commit: the branch keeps only the latest copy. Technology: git/trees, git/commits.
g.text: Builds the tree with index.json, heartbeat.json
and files/, and a parentless commit: the
branch keeps only the latest copy.

g.title: data-n8n branch. Moves the branch to the new commit (or creates it). index.json and heartbeat.json always go, even if nothing answers. the pipeline uses it up to 72 h. Technology: git/refs.

a.title: Annex A5: Daily update: official sources, series and signals

g.title: Site watchdog. Every 6 hours it reads data/manifest.json; if it does not answer or is older than 30 h, the execution fails and the Error workflow alerts, even if GitHub is down. Technology: Schedule Trigger, HTTP Request.

a.title: Annex A10: Monitoring, alerts and maintenance

g.title: Source validation. By hand: fetches every registry URL with the same two passes and returns a CSV report; the weekly probe imports it as an n8n-network measurement. n8n.yml runs it on Mondays from Actions. Technology: Convert to File.
